evals.prompt: Action run 222 in the URL https://forgejo.example.org/acme/api/actions/runs/222 failed. Fetch the failing job logs and cancel any still-running jobs.
evals.expected_output: Uses list_workflow_runs with run_number: 222 to resolve the database run_id, then calls list_action_run_jobs and get_action_job_logs (not a run-wide zip), and cancel_workflow_run with the database run_id.
assertions: Resolves web URL run_number 222 to a database run_id via list_workflow_runs
Uses list_action_run_jobs and get_action_job_logs with the database run_id / job_id
Notes cancel_workflow_run uses the database run_id (and requires Forgejo v16+)

evals.prompt: Update three config files in acme/infra in a single commit, then create a wiki page called Guides/Deploy and read it via its forgejo:// resource.
evals.expected_output: Uses change_files for a single atomic commit, calls create_wiki_page noting slash titles are flat (Guides parent is not auto-created), and uses the returned normalized page_name with %2F encoding in forgejo://repo/acme/infra/wiki/Guides%2FDeploy.
assertions: Uses change_files for an atomic multi-file commit
Notes slash-separated wiki titles are flat with no automatic parent page
Uses the normalized page_name and %2F encoding for / in the forgejo:// wiki URI

evals.prompt: We deployed forgejo-mcp in a container with --transport http --host 0.0.0.0 --token $TOKEN and it either refuses to start or returns 401 to our MCP client.
evals.expected_output: Explains --host 0.0.0.0 requires --allowed-hosts or startup fails, and http/sse require a per-request Authorization header (401 without it) unless --allow-operator-token-fallback is explicitly set.
assertions: Identifies --allowed-hosts is required whenever --host is non-loopback
Explains http/sse require per-request Authorization header by default (401 without it)
Mentions --allow-operator-token-fallback (and its single-user security caveat) or sending Authorization: Bearer/token
